ios.desc:
Keep your phone safe while you focus on your workout.
Sentry Motion alerts your Apple Watch the moment your iPhone is touched, moved, or picked up—so you can train with confidence. Designed for the gym, pool, and any environment where your phone may be at risk.

Movement detection with multiple sensitivity levels

Instant haptic alerts on your Apple Watch

Works even while the Workout app is running

Easily enable or disable Sentry Mode

Mute or dismiss alarms directly from your watch or phone

Sentry Motion keeps watch over your phone—so you can keep watch over your goals.

quotes.text:
Got tired of glancing at my phone every 5 minutes at the gym or pool, wondering if someone would grab it. So I built Watch Over just for me: it watches for motion on your iPhone and pings your Apple Watch right away if anything moves. Simple, no subscription, one-time buy.
I never planned to put it out there, but it worked so well, I decided why not share it.
It's live now if anyone's interested: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/watch-over/id6755927643
